name: uae-gratuity-calculator
description: Calculates UAE end-of-service gratuity under the mainland labour law, non-financial free zones, DIFC (including DEWS) and ADGM, with the law cited and assumptions shown.

interface.longDescription: Enter your start date, last working day and monthly basic salary. The calculator applies the 21-day and 30-day rates, the one-year minimum, unpaid leave, part-time hours and the cap under Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021. DIFC employees see the gratuity owed for service before February 2020 and their DEWS contribution rate. ADGM employees get the 2024 rules with no cap. Every answer shows the law it used and the assumptions where the law is silent. General information only, not personalised advice.
defaultPrompt: Calculate my UAE gratuity: joined 1 April 2017, leaving 30 September 2026, basic salary AED 18,000.
How is end-of-service gratuity worked out in DIFC since DEWS started?
I'm resigning after 7 years in Dubai. What gratuity am I owed?
